title: Rule 7 security oracle validates address encodings independently instead of shared mode
description: python/tests/test_protocol_vector_security.py derives source_encoding and destination_encoding independently from each address prefix. Rule 7 has one shared AddressMode bit: IID mode is canonical only when both endpoints are fe80::/64; otherwise both fields are full. The oracle therefore rejects the correct mixed fe90/fe80 vector and could bless a mixed encoding. Derive the expected encoding once from the address pair and assert both fields agree.
